issues.title: Ingest Faulkner County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $72,110,702 across 45 funds. The largest: County General ($16,383,000), County Road ($12,331,627), County Road Sales Tax ($9,215,000). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
